calendar: Monday-Friday only; no real exchange holidays or intraday timestamps
missing: Empty CSV cell means missing; never forward-filled

series.name: USD IG OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. investment grade, broad corporate; illustrative spread duration 5.5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD HY OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. high yield, broad corporate; illustrative spread duration 3.5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD banks OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. investment grade, banks; illustrative spread duration 4.5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD industrials OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. investment grade, industrials; illustrative spread duration 6 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD broad credit OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. mixed ratings, broad credit risk reference; illustrative spread duration 5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD EM sovereign HY OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. high yield, emerging sovereigns; illustrative spread duration 6.5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD agency MBS OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. agency mortgages, option-adjusted; illustrative spread duration 4 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: EUR IG OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. investment grade, broad corporate; illustrative spread duration 5 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: GBP IG OAS
series.description: SYNTHETIC. investment grade, broad corporate; illustrative spread duration 6 years. Different credit quality, composition and duration remain. No FX hedge or curve rebasing.

series.name: USD 2Y yield
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Yield quoted in percent: 1.0 means 1%, not a decimal return.

series.name: USD 5Y yield
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Yield quoted in percent: 1.0 means 1%, not a decimal return.

series.name: USD 10Y yield
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Yield quoted in percent: 1.0 means 1%, not a decimal return.

series.name: USD 10Y yield in bp
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream conversion: usd_10y_yield_pct multiplied by 100.

series.name: USD 10Y minus 2Y
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: (10Y yield percent minus 2Y yield percent) multiplied by 100.

series.name: USD IG OAS in percent
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Same USD IG spread divided by 100. Convert observations before a bp difference.

series.name: USD IG total return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Base 100 on 2010-01-04. Toy carry/duration model with fixed duration 5.5; no default losses, convexity or trading costs. Percentage change is synthetic index return.

series.name: USD IG spread duration
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Fixed illustrative spread duration used in the toy credit total-return model.

series.name: USD HY total return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Base 250 on 2010-01-04. Toy carry/duration model with fixed duration 3.5; no default losses, convexity or trading costs. Percentage change is synthetic index return.

series.name: USD HY spread duration
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Fixed illustrative spread duration used in the toy credit total-return model.

series.name: USD broad equity total return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Base 100; broad equity risk reference. Arbitrary raw bases are not relative value. Percentage change is index return.

series.name: USD bank equity total return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Base 7000; return sensitivity rises from 1.15 to 1.65 on 2022-01-03. Arbitrary raw bases are not relative value. Percentage change is index return.

series.name: EUR equity total return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Base 250; native EUR returns. Arbitrary raw bases are not relative value. Percentage change is index return.

series.name: USD broad equity price index
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Total-return path with a deterministic income factor removed. Percentage change is price return.

series.name: EURUSD spot
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Quote direction fixed. Multiply EUR wealth by EURUSD for unhedged USD wealth; no hedge supplied.

series.name: EUR equity in USD
series.comparison_basis: USD, income reinvested, unhedged FX conversion
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: eur_equity_tr * eurusd / initial eurusd. Base 250; FX contributes to returns.

series.name: usd ig tr rebased
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: 100 * usd_ig_tr(t) / usd_ig_tr(2015-01-02); earlier dates missing. Level comparisons describe growth since that date.

series.name: usd hy tr rebased
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: 100 * usd_hy_tr(t) / usd_hy_tr(2015-01-02); earlier dates missing. Level comparisons describe growth since that date.

series.name: usd equity tr rebased
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: 100 * usd_equity_tr(t) / usd_equity_tr(2015-01-02); earlier dates missing. Level comparisons describe growth since that date.

series.name: usd banks tr rebased
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: 100 * usd_banks_tr(t) / usd_banks_tr(2015-01-02); earlier dates missing. Level comparisons describe growth since that date.

series.name: eur equity usd tr rebased
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Upstream shaping: 100 * eur_equity_usd_tr(t) / eur_equity_usd_tr(2015-01-02); earlier dates missing. Level comparisons describe growth since that date.

series.name: USD policy rate
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Quarter-point decisions every 65 weekday sessions; unchanged values between decisions are actual model levels. Most daily policy changes are zero; all-date change ratios are unsuitable event statistics.

series.name: USD deposit rate
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Partial, delayed pass-through: each session closes 6% of the gap to 65% of policy rate.

series.name: usd equity tr monthly return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. 100 * (usd_equity_tr at last weekday of month / previous month end - 1). Use Measure Level; blank between month ends. Sparse regression/freshness limits still apply.

series.name: usd banks tr monthly return
series.description: SYNTHETIC. 100 * (usd_banks_tr at last weekday of month / previous month end - 1). Use Measure Level; blank between month ends. Sparse regression/freshness limits still apply.

series.name: Gapped IG spread
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Missing every 37th session and 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-21; test exact-date alignment and missing baselines.

series.name: Stopped IG spread
series.description: SYNTHETIC. No values after 2026-09-11. Missing tail is not a zero move.

series.name: New IG spread series
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Only the final 40 sessions; insufficient for the 500-observation reference floor and 60-sample risk floor.

series.name: Constant spread
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Exactly 100 bp. Zero variance, unusable volatility divisor and constant regression predictor.

series.name: Yield crossing zero
series.comparison_basis: Synthetic signed yield, no curve mapping
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Repeated negative/zero/positive baselines. Absolute changes retain meaning; ordinary percentage growth does not.

series.name: Zero and tiny denominator
series.description: SYNTHETIC. Repeats 0, 0.000001, -0.000001, 10, -10 bp. No economically valid all-date ratio distribution.

series.name: Inverse credit sensitivity
series.description: SYNTHETIC. 1000 minus twice broad credit OAS. Stable negative beta to that reference is intentional, not a hedge.

series.name: Tiny credit sensitivity
series.description: SYNTHETIC. 100 plus 0.0001 times broad credit OAS. Numerically nonzero beta can be economically unusable as a divisor.
